name: Proton Drive
author: Encelyte
description: Proton Drive in the Omarchy bar: two-way sync of a folder through Proton's official CLI, sign-in, storage, and recent sync activity. Unofficial; not affiliated with Proton AG.

barWidget.description: Two-way sync between a local folder and a Proton Drive folder, with sign-in, storage used, and recent activity.

schema.label: Local folder
schema.description: The folder on this computer to keep in sync.

schema.label: Proton Drive folder
schema.description: A folder inside My files, e.g. /my-files/Documents. Created if missing.

schema.label: Ignore
schema.description: Comma-separated folders or files to leave out of the sync. A bare name matches anywhere; a path like site/assets matches from the sync folder. Wildcards work.
